name: Proving ground: intercept trial
brief: A test-range exercise. Red fires tactical ballistic missiles at a range target; Blue's battery must detect and intercept them. Everything is a fictional game system with game ratings.

name: East China Sea: Japan vs China
brief: Test conflict in the East China Sea. China (Red) opens with Rocket Force salvos on Japanese bases; Japan (Blue) answers with Type 12 regiments. Both sides defend with land SAMs and air-defence ships. Cities are protected and never targeted.

name: Middle East: Israel vs Iran
brief: Test conflict between Israel (Blue) and Iran (Red). Iran sends drones and cruise missiles first, then times ballistic salvos to arrive with them; Israel's layered air defence (Arrow 3, Arrow 2, David's Sling, Iron Dome) defends, then Israel strikes missile bases with tanker-supported packages. Cities are protected and never targeted; nuclear forces stay abstract.
